rule: A deployed version passes when, for each case, its answer carries the same facts as tool_output.

cases.question: Someone asks whether recap quotations occur in their referenced messages and whether review, confidentiality and destination gates allow posting. Use the ThreadEvidenceView tool on the sample.
cases.local_answer:
I ran the recap check on the sample, but it can't fully answer your question because I didn't pass it any messages or gate settings.

- **Quote check:** The tool returned one recap item, a risk from message M1: "Contoso launch remains on hold pending budget approval." It did not verify that this quote appears in M1, because I didn't supply the message text.
- **Posting gates:** `may_post` is false. The tool did not report which gate blocked posting. I didn't set review, confidentiality, or destination flags, and the destination is null.
- **Side effects:** Nothing was posted, and no mail was modified.

To get a real verdict, I need the message bodies (ids and text), the recap items (category, message_id, quote), and whether the recap was reviewed, whether the thread is confidential, and the destination team and channel. Send those and I'll rerun the check.
